entries.title: Physics Nobel Prize
entries.text: This year, the Physics Nobel Prize went to the IceCube, a telescope made from a cubic kilometer of ice in Antarctica to detect neutrinos, the “ghost particle” nobody has ever seen. Come find out how you build a telescope out of a glacier, what it found, and why Hawaii almost got there first. Join the Physics Club, today, Thursday 11/12 during lunch in W104.

entries.title: World Kindness Day
entries.text: Make kindness a little sweeter! Celebrate World Kindness Day tomorrow, Fri, Nov 13, with Spirit Kinds Kandy Kebabs! Stop by the Pā during lunch to create your own candy kebab with your favorite sweets and leave a kind note to brighten someone’s day. We can’t wait to see you there!--ALOHA FRIDAY AT THE Pā Grab your friends and your lunch - and come touch grass! Join us tomorrow, for Aloha Friday at the Pā, featuring live music, good vibes, and performances by Barron Hamamoto ’27, Eyan Tsuchiyama ’29, and surprise guests!+

entries.title: Orchestra Performance
entries.text: Don't miss the Orchestra 4 & 5 performance on Sat, Nov 14 at 7 p.m. at the beautiful Moanalua High School Performing Arts Center. Click to purchase tickets ($5) online. We are positive you will enjoy the scintillating sounds of strings presenting music by well-known composers including: Tchaikovsky, Dvraok, Mozart, Paganini, Grainger, and more. This concert features the first of our senior Concerto Competition winners -- Christopher Oyama '27 performing the exciting Violin Concerto by Jean Sibelius, Mvt III -- and also includes musicians from our Band program to create the ‘Iolani Symphony Orchestra.

entries.title: Marching Band and Dance Team Senior Night
entries.text: Come to Kozuki Stadium this Sunday 11/15 to watch the FINAL performance of "The Magic Show." This free performance will start at 5 pm followed by a short ceremony to honor our marching band and IDT seniors. Lei giving on the field will continue until 6 pm. Stop by our merchandise table before or after the performance to buy candy lei and other 'Iolani Marching Band merchandise. All proceeds will go towards the marching band program."

entries.title: Future Business Leaders of America
entries.text: FBLA is excited to announce our upcoming school conference on Nov 24, with the award ceremony on Nov 25! Students can compete in a variety of events, with overall top scorers receiving a $50 gift card and finalists earning medals and certificates. ALL (you do not need to be in FBLA) interested students are encouraged to register and showcase their skills. Please register using this link by this Sunday, Nov 15: https://forms.gle/CzYHhN7MZPiWEwkw9 Please contact klp2801@iolani.org or ec2801@iolani.org for more information.

entries.title: Food4thought - Processing Our Produce!
entries.text: Weʻve looked at production in our food cycle; the next step is PROCESSING. If we choose processing methods like freezing, dehydrating, canning, and pickling, we can keep our fresh, healthy foods for a longer time and avoid wasting food, when we have extra. Check out how easy it is to make garlic-y pickled carrots!

entries.title: Cooking Workshop
entries.text: The Food4Thought club invites you to an exciting cooking workshop hosted by the ‘Iolani Gastro students on Monday, November 16th in the SCIL4F kitchen space at lunch. Enjoy a live cooking demonstration and taste some delicious dishes that transform common holiday leftover items into new culinary sensations while reducing food waste. Space is limited to 30 so make sure to sign up HERE and reserve your spot ASAP! For more info feel free to email achristie@iolani.org.

entries.title: Human Society's Roaring Night in Paradise Gala
entries.text: Every year, the Hawaiian Humane Society Junior Development Council hosts a gala to raise money for animals in need. This year’s theme is A Roaring Night in Paradise, and we’re inviting 500 teens ages 13–18 to join us for a semi-formal evening filled with a dinner buffet, raffle prizes, games, and a photo booth! The event will be hosted at Alohilani on February 13th from 5-9pm. Purchase your ticket by December 20 and receive a FREE raffle ticket for a chance to win a gift card! A parent consent form is included in the ticket link. Contact Rylie Yamamoto ’27, Chairman of the Hawaiian Humane Society Junior. Jr. Tuxes The Roaring 20s eventbrite.com
